AbilityDef.label: rain
AbilityDef.description:
Open the carrier's frame and throw a dozen blades into the sky over a chosen place.

What lands is not the point. Half of them will hit nothing, and the ones that do hit are not what kills anybody. What matters is that they are still standing there afterwards - in a doorway, across a corridor, behind the line somebody is holding - because everything else this gene does is done with blades that are already in the ground.

The carrier is lighter afterwards, and worse at everything, for exactly as long as the blades are out.

AbilityDef.label: loose
AbilityDef.description:
Every blade standing near the chosen point lifts, turns to face it, and goes.

Each one flies from the cell it happens to be in, so the volley has the shape the rain had. Blades behind the target do not care what is in front of them, blades in the open have a clean line, and blades on the wrong side of a wall spend themselves on the wall.

They do not come back. Wherever each one stops is where it is standing now, which is often much closer to the people it was thrown at.

AbilityDef.label: grasp
AbilityDef.description:
The nearest planted blade tears out of the ground and flies to an open hand - the carrier's own, or anyone else's within sight.

What arrives is an ordinary steel longsword, and it stays one. A blade in the ground belongs to the body that made it and can never be picked up by anybody; a blade in a hand has been paid for and is simply a weapon somebody owns now.

The hand has to be empty. Nothing here will put a colonist's rifle on the floor to make room.
